# Release

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Release`](gmeow-Release.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Release>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A software release — an event that produces a versioned software product, typically associated with a tag, a DOI, and one or more distribution artifacts. The event facet of the five-facet model; a release is an occurrence, not the product itself.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

Use [`gmeow:Release`](gmeow-Release.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
